headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Khaitan & Co act on Bonfiglioli ₹2,533 crore IPO

detail: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares comprised of an offer for sale by Bonfiglioli S.p.A., the company’s promoter, aggregating to ₹2,533.66 crore. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co (SAM) advised Bonfiglioli Transmissions and its promoter, Bonfiglioli S.p.A., on this IPO. The transaction team consisted of Nikhil Naredi (Partner), Karun Prakash (Partner), Trishita Dasgupta (Partner), Harini Jambunathan (Senior Associate), Anaya Jain (Associate) and Gouri Mahabalshetti (Associate). Ritika Khare (Principal Associate) provided assistance.
